scoring_justification: Cannot recompute metric from raw artifact; the artifact is the final summary swarm parameters. Fall back to T0 result-level comparison against hidden gold from SCENA Table 1.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold swarm parameters (mean energy, drift velocity, diffusion coefficient) for Reid model at E/N = 1, 10, 20 Td.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from published Table 1 of the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported validation values; no synthetic data.

outputs.description: Electron swarm parameters for the Reid model at E/N = 1, 10, 20 Td. The array must contain exactly three objects, one per reduced field. Checker compares each numeric value to the hidden gold from SCENA Table 1 within hidden absolute tolerances.

output_contract.notes: Only the three specified reduced electric fields (1, 10, 20 Td) are required. The agent must use the exact units stated.
